body:
m1 - SHA fec38fb on m1/blend-support, base 7aad1ae. One verification pass, as the chief asked. All three of your holds are addressed.

1. THE DEFAULT IS GONE. supportWeight is required on AlignWire.costBreakdown. Removing it made the compiler name the two negative-law reconstructions you identified, Laws.scala:517 and :526, which now pass b.supportWeight.

2. ZERO SUPPORT IS NOW AN EXCLUSION, NOT A [0,1] WIDENING ALONE. You were right that widening the guard did not settle it. New Exclusion.Unassessable, distinct from Unreachable because Unreachable claims something about the REFERENCE and this claims something about the EVIDENCE. cost() returns it when support <= 0, so the state is DROPPED from the space (hsmm builds states from !b.excluded) rather than priced at the function prior, below the external floor. The [0,1] guard stays because supportWeight 0.0 is the honest value the exclusion carries.

3. hsmm/v2, NO MIGRATION, per the chief. Resource renamed to hsmm-v2-wog.json.

GATE: ten modules, TEN totals, zero failures - align 201, amrInterop 92, codec 107, core 123, embedBench 64, embedGrakern 28, fixtures 117, interview 92, laws 86, view 40. scalafmtCheckAll last, clean. I counted the totals against the modules this time; last round a codec failure aborted the sequence before laws ran and I read a three-total log for a five-module run as green.

TWO GOLDEN DIFFS, both fully accounted so you can check them arithmetically rather than by eye:
  supportWeight  -> 32f509c9, 25,960 bytes, +666 = 18 keys x 37 bytes (canonical hex doubles, so
                    every key is the same width; 0x3ff0000000000000 on ten cells, 0x3fee9131abf0b767
                    on eight)
  hsmm/v2        -> 13222a02, 25,960 bytes, +0 bytes; exactly one v1 token became one v2

ONE THING I DELIBERATELY DID NOT CHANGE and you should confirm I was right to leave: the suite has a
StorySource titled 'wog-hsmm-v1' at WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenSuite:62. That is an INPUT to the
content address, not a schema reference. Renaming it would have moved the fingerprint for a cosmetic
reason and produced a golden diff I could not account for. If you disagree that it should keep a v1
name, say so - it is the one judgement call in the rename.

Thank you for the hold. The candidate you stopped had passed ten modules and 948 tests.
